Odette Technologies | Senior Integration Engineer, Data/ML Engineer, Product Lead | HYBRID (NC) / REMOTE | Full-time | US citizens, clearable, East Coast-based | https://odettetechnologies.com

We're building an AI-powered situational awareness platform for intelligence and information operations teams, helping analysts and decision-makers make sense of overwhelming open and closed source data. Small, operator-founded team.

All three are first hires in their function. You'll work on hard problems: entity resolution across messy multilingual text, taking prototypes to production, and building product for defense and intel users. Python and LLM experience preferred for the engineering roles.

Apply: careers@odettetechnologies.com with "HN" and the role in the subject line. Full descriptions on our site.
